# Alprax Flow

> Secure, fast cross-border payments with competitive exchange rates and low fees. Send money worldwide with an AI-powered autonomous payment agent built on Stellar.

Alprax Flow is a global remittance and payments platform that abstracts blockchain infrastructure to deliver a fiat-first user experience. Users can send money across borders, set up automated payment rules in natural language, and pay with familiar currencies — all powered by Stellar under the hood.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page introducing Alprax Flow.
- [Welcome](/welcome): Onboarding tour for new users.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an Alprax Flow account.
